# ADR-052: The spec-to-code chain is mirrored into Utopia on every ingest

## Amendment 2026-10-16: commit history under ontology version 4

- **A cursor, not a delta.** lore-api walks the branch above `settings.utopia.commits_head`, oldest-first, 2,000 commits a walk, and moves the cursor past each commit that landed whole, so the whole history arrives over as many walks as it takes and a failed push is retried by the next. The walks of one repo run one after the other in a process, so a push during a walk cannot move the cursor back, and the settings writer merges into the `utopia` block so a setup or an upgrade keeps the cursor. The weekly backfill runs the walk after the documents; the stations post it on every push, through a route that skips any branch but the default one.

- **`specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md` FR4.3**: A user querying a repo's Utopia knowledge base after a default-branch `POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/ingest` (`kind: "test-report"`) now sees test items (`test:<path>`) with pass/fail outcomes and coverage links alongside specs and ADRs, whereas non-default branch test reports remain isolated in the Dgraph branch overlay and do not pollute Utopia.
- **`specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md` FR4.4**: A CI caller posting a `test-report` delta receives the same `200` response with `test_chunks` and `pruned_test_files` counts even when the Utopia mirror push fails, while operators see `[utopia-mirror] <repo> <path>: <message>` in logs and an increment on `lore_utopia_mirror_failures_total`.

content.text: {"answer": "No. A failed Utopia push doesn't fail the ingest. The mirror is best-effort. In the spec-to-Utopia mirror spec (FR4.4), a CI caller still gets the normal `200` response with its counts, such as `test_chunks` and `pruned_test_files`, when the mirror push fails. The failure is logged as `[utopia-mirror] <repo> <path>: <message>` and increments the `lore_utopia_mirror_failures_total` metric. ADR-052 says a failed push is retried by the next walk, at least for commit history. I confirmed this from the test-report delta case. I didn't find a separate statement that covers spec pushes specifically.", "sources": ["specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md (FR4.4)", "adrs/ADR-052-code-to-spec-graph-mirrored-in-utopia.md"]}
